agenda_items.title: 2026 Assistance to Community Groups – Cash Awards [PDCS2026-0501]
agenda_items.content: General Manager, Community Services Anger introduced the matter and noted that the recommendation had been updated to reflect that the Committee has the delegated authority to approve assistance for community groups. Director of Planning and Development Anderson presented the report. Councillor MacDonald joined the meeting virtually at 9:37 a.m. The Committee heard from the following speakers: Chantelle Johnson, CLASSIC Sheryl Harrow-Yurach, Foundations Learning & Skills Saskatchewan
agenda_items.recommendation: That the Standing Policy Committee on Planning, Development and Community Services recommend to City Council that cash grants totalling $630,600 under the Social Services Category, Assistance to Community Groups Grant Program, as outlined in this report from the Community Services Division, dated May 6, 2026, be approved.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (5) Councillor Davies, Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Kelleher, Councillor Parker, and Councillor Timon Absent: (1) Mayor Block CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY

agenda_items.title: Proposed Name – Sunrise – University Heights 3 Neighbourhood [ADV2026-0405]
agenda_items.content: The Committee heard from Senator Nora Cummings regarding the matter. Auntie Advocate Swiftwolfe responded to questions regarding the language of the proposed name Sunrise. General Manager, Community Services Anger introduced the item and Chief Strategy and Transformation Officer Richards presented the report with slides. Together with Auntie Advocate Swiftwolfe, Director of Saskatoon Land Long, Planning Project Services Manager Schulz, and Director of Planning and Development Anderson, they responded to questions regarding the cultural significance of the name Hawthorn to Indigenous communities, the cost and funding of the engagement process, and how names are put forward and master list of names is applied.
agenda_items.recommendation: That the proposed Hawthorn name be added to the Names Master List under the theme of Flora and Fauna; That the proposed Sunrise name be added to the Names Master List under the theme of Environment; That Sunrise be applied to the University Heights 3 Neighbourhood; and That the December 11, 2025, and April 17, 2026, reports of the Community Services Division be forwarded to City Council for information.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (5) Councillor Davies, Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Kelleher, Councillor Parker, and Councillor Timon Absent: (1) Mayor Block CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY

agenda_items.title: Vacant Lot and Adaptive Reuse Incentive Program – 410 to 420 3rd Avenue North and 324 24th Street West [PDCS2026-0503]
agenda_items.content: Neighbourhood Planning Manager Austen presented the report.
agenda_items.recommendation: That the Standing Policy Committee on Planning, Development and Community Services recommend to City Council: That a 5-year tax abatement, equivalent to 100% of the incremental Municipal and Library property taxes, for the development of 410 to 420 3rd Avenue North, be approved, commencing the earlier of January 1, 2030, or the next taxation year, following completion of the project; That Corporate Revenue submit an application under the Provincial Government’s Education Property Tax Exemption/Abatement Program seeking approval for a 5-year tax abatement, equivalent to 100% of the incremental Education property taxes, for the development of 410 to 420 3rd Avenue North; That the City Solicitor prepare the appropriate agreements, and that the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized to execute the agreements under the Corporate Seal; and Authorize payment of a one-time grant for the adaptive reuse of 324 24th Street West, if the project is completed within 3 years from approval of this report. The grant shall not exceed the annual Municipal and Library taxes assessed to the property following completion of the project.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (5) Councillor Davies, Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Kelleher, Councillor Parker, and Councillor Timon Absent: (1) Mayor Block CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY
